topArticle.title: At least 57 people die as tens of thousands cross to Spanish enclave of Ceuta from Morocco
topArticle.description:
Pedro Sánchez decries ‘violation of territorial integrity’ as other EU countries criticise Madrid over incident
At least 57 people have died trying to reach the Spanish enclave of Ceuta after as many as 50,000 migrants entered the tiny territory from Morocco in what Spain’s prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, called “a violation of Spain’s territorial integrity”.
The huge influx, which took place over the course of just 24 hours, overwhelmed the city of 85,000 people, triggered a political crisis for Madrid and led to a mixed reaction from other EU countries, including calls for Spain to be suspended from the Schengen free-movement zone.

topArticle.title: Canadians spent $3.3bn less on travel to US in 2025 after Trump’s return to office

Data shows Canadians have replaced US vacations with other international trips in apparent rebuke to Trump
Canadians spent $3.3bn less on travel to the US in 2025 than in the previous year, as Donald Trump’s hostile policies towards his northern neighbour continue to incur an economic cost, new government data shows.
The research also indicates that Canadians are not bucking travel overall and instead have replaced US vacations with other international destinations, in a rebuke to Trump’s tariff regime and the president’s continued musings on annexing Canada.

topArticle.title: The Chinese graduate accused of being Mexico's 'fentanyl king'
topArticle.description: Cartel members and ex-colleagues describe how Zhang Zhidong allegedly linked Chinese chemicals to Mexican drug labs.
topArticle.titleJa: メキシコの「フェンタニル王」と称される中国人卒業生
topArticle.summary: 中国人卒業生が、メキシコで中国の化学物質と麻薬製造ラボを結びつけ、「フェンタニル王」として非難されている。

topArticle.title: Five dead and 41 missing after Indonesia ferry catches fire
topArticle.description: The vessel with at least 250 people on board caught fire off Madura island.
topArticle.titleJa: インドネシアのフェリー火災で5人死亡、41人行方不明
topArticle.summary: マドゥラ島沖でフェリーが炎上し、少なくとも5人が死亡、41人が行方不明。船には250人以上が乗船していた。

topArticle.title: How Australia combines modern tech and Indigenous knowledge to fight wildfires
topArticle.description: As Europe faces its worst wildfires in decades, Australia offers lessons in disaster preparedness.
topArticle.titleJa: オーストラリアがいかに現代技術と先住民の知識を組み合わせて山火事と闘うか
topArticle.summary: 記録的な山火事に見舞われるヨーロッパに対し、オーストラリアが現代技術と先住民の知恵を融合させた山火事対策の教訓を提示する。

topArticle.title: Greyhounds bound for Australia as New Zealand racing ban takes effect
topArticle.description: At least two chartered flights carrying up to 150 greyhounds are set to fly to Australia's eastern states, the BBC understands.
topArticle.titleJa: ニュージーランドの競走禁止を受けて、グレイハウンドがオーストラリアへ
topArticle.summary: ニュージーランドでグレイハウンドレース禁止が発効し、最大150頭のグレイハウンドがチャーター便でオーストラリア東部へ移送される予定。

topArticle.title: WTO panel issues report regarding Turkish measures on EVs and other types of vehicles
topArticle.description: On 28 July, the WTO circulated the panel report in the case brought by China in "Türkiye — Measures Concerning Electric Vehicles and Other Types of Vehicles from China" (DS629).
topArticle.titleJa: WTOパネル、トルコによるEVなどの車両に関する措置について報告書を発行
topArticle.summary: WTOは、中国が提起したトルコの電気自動車などに関する措置についてのパネル報告書を回覧した。

topArticle.title: Lithuania gives EUR 30,000 to help developing economies and LDCs improve trade skillset
topArticle.description: Lithuania is contributing EUR 30,000 (approximately CHF 28,000) in 2026 to finance training programmes for government officials from developing economies, including least-developed countries (LDCs). This contribution to the WTO Global Trust Fund will support these economies in deepening their expertise on WTO issues and help them participate more effectively in the rules-based multilateral trading system.
topArticle.titleJa: リトアニア、発展途上国やLDCの貿易スキル向上を支援するため3万ユーロを拠出
topArticle.summary: リトアニアは、発展途上国および後発開発途上国の政府職員向け訓練プログラムに3万ユーロを拠出し、WTO関連の専門知識深化を支援する。

topArticle.title: Uzbekistan reaffirms 2026 WTO accession goal, thanks members for continuing engagement
topArticle.description: Uzbekistan reaffirmed its determination to complete its WTO accession process within 2026 at a meeting of the Working Party on the Accession of Uzbekistan on 27 and 28 July, soon after its last meeting in March. The head of Uzbekistan's delegation, Chief Negotiator Azizbek Urunov, stressed that maintaining a strong pace of engagement and addressing members' remaining concerns will be critical to bringing the accession process to a successful conclusion.
topArticle.titleJa: ウズベキスタン、2026年のWTO加盟目標を再確認し、継続的な協力に感謝
topArticle.summary: ウズベキスタンは、2026年までのWTO加盟プロセス完了への決意を再確認し、加盟国への継続的な協力に感謝を表明した。
